nodes.description: Ownable.owner: public address holding the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender in the constructor.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that overwrites owner with newOwner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets owner to address(0), irrevocably removing privileged access.
BaseWallet._owner: internal storage slot holding the smart wallet owner.
BaseWallet.initOwner(address): one-time initializer callable only by the wallet factory.
BaseWallet.setOwner(address): owner replacement callable only from an authorized module.
BaseWallet.addModule(address): registers a module, callable from factory or existing module.
BaseWallet.removeModule(address): deactivates and deletes a module, callable only from a module.
BaseWallet.transact(uint8,address,uint,bytes): generic external transaction entry point gated by onlyFromFactoryOrModule.
BaseWallet.fallback(): forwards msg.data to the module bound to msg.sig.
BaseWallet._call(uint8,address,uint,bytes): private dispatcher performing call, delegatecall or staticcall.
BaseWallet._addModule(address,ModuleRegistry): validates, records and activates a module.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller identity used across all authorization modifiers.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used for guardian, quota and whitelist timing.
target.call/delegatecall/staticcall{value}(data) inside BaseWallet._call: arbitrary external execution from the wallet.
module.call{value: msg.value}(msg.data) inside BaseWallet.fallback: forwards full calldata and value to a bound module.
BaseWallet.modules: mapping(address=>bool) authorizing modules.
BaseWallet.controller: Controller instance defining the wallet factory and stores.
BaseWallet.methodToModule: mapping(bytes4=>address) binding selectors to modules.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue: storage mutex used by the nonReentrant modifier.
BaseWallet.init(Controller,address[]): one-time controller and initial module setup.
BaseWallet.setController(Controller): replaces the controller, callable only from a module.
BaseWallet.bindMethod(bytes4,address): binds or unbinds a selector to a module.
BaseModule.activate(): binds methods for the wallet identified by msg.sender.
BaseModule.deactivate(): unbinds methods for the wallet identified by msg.sender.
GuardianStore.addGuardian(address,address,uint,bool): schedules or overrides a guardian addition.
GuardianStore.removeGuardian(address,address,uint,bool): schedules or overrides a guardian removal.
SecurityStore.setLock(address,bool): toggles the wallet lock flag (module only).
SecurityStore.touchLastActive(address): writes block.timestamp into lastActive.
SecurityStore.setInheritor(address,address,uint32): configures inheritance and refreshes lastActive.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent(address,address,uint,PriceOracle): quota gate before value leaves the wallet.
QuotaStore.changeQuota(address,uint,uint): schedules a new daily quota (module only).
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate(address,bytes32): replay protection, requires the caller to be a wallet module.
HashStore.hashes: mapping(address=>mapping(bytes32=>bool)) of consumed signed-request hashes.
QuotaStore.quotas: mapping(address=>Quota) holding current/pending quota and spent amounts.
GuardianStore.wallets: mapping(address=>Wallet) holding guardians, inheritor and lock data.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap: mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of whitelist activation times.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist(address,address,uint): whitelists an address, clamping effective time to block.timestamp.
Claimable.transferOwnership(address): records a pending owner instead of transferring immediately.
Claimable.claimOwnership(): pending owner finalizes the ownership transfer.
Claimable.pendingOwner: address authorized to claim ownership.
owner = address(0) inside renounceOwnership: permanently deletes the privileged role.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeTo(address): onlyProxyOwner implementation upgrade.
OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes): upgrades then calls itself with msg.value.
address(this).call{value: msg.value}(data) in upgradeToAndCall: self-directed arbitrary execution.
delegatecall(gas(), _impl, ...) in Proxy.fallback: executes implementation code in the proxy storage context.
Proxy.fallback(): delegatecalls implementation() for every unmatched call.
UpgraderModule.activate(): upgrades the caller wallet, swaps modules, migrates guardians, then removes itself.
GuardianStore.removeAllGuardians(address): wipes the guardian set of a wallet.
GuardianStore.cancelPendingGuardians(address): cancels pending guardian additions/removals.
AddressSet.sets: mapping(bytes32=>Set) backing manager, dapp and whitelist membership.
OwnerManagable.addManager(address): onlyOwner addition of a privileged manager.
GuardianStore._cleanRemovedGuardians(address,bool): compacts the guardian array and index mapping.
Module(_module).activate() inside _addModule: external callback into a newly registered module.
OwnerManagable.removeManager(address): onlyOwner removal of a manager.
SecurityStore.touchLastActiveWhenRequired(address,uint): refreshes lastActive once the inactivity interval has elapsed.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into Ownable.owner during construction.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged owner address.
the newOwner argument flows directly into the owner state variable.
the onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender.
renounceOwnership executes the owner-zeroing unsafe operation.
ownership removal writes address(0) into owner.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender.
initOwner assigns the initial owner into _owner.
_initialOwner is stored in the wallet owner slot.
onlyFromFactory compares msg.sender with controller.walletFactory().
setOwner replaces the wallet owner slot.
the newOwner argument is written into _owner.
onlyFromModule checks modules[msg.sender] before granting owner change rights.
the modules mapping authorizes msg.sender in the wallet modifiers.
addModule delegates the registration logic to _addModule.
_addModule performs an external Module.activate() call after recording the module.
the activated module can re-enter the wallet before _addModule returns.
_addModule sets modules[_module] = true, granting module privileges.
the module address argument becomes the key of the authorization mapping.
removeModule deletes modules[_module] from the authorization mapping.
init loops over the initial modules and calls _addModule.
transact forwards mode, to, value and data to the internal _call helper.
_call performs the low-level call/delegatecall/staticcall to an arbitrary target.
the external callee regains control while the wallet transaction is still in progress.
the success flag of transact is produced by the low-level call.
caller-supplied calldata is forwarded verbatim to the external call.
the target parameter is the address receiving the low-level call.
the value parameter is attached as msg.value of the low-level call.
the mode parameter selects between call, delegatecall and staticcall inside _call.
the _call mode parameter drives its internal branch selection.
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the module bound to msg.sig.
the called module can re-enter the wallet fallback before the first execution finishes.
the bound module address resolved from methodToModule is the call target.
fallback reads methodToModule[msg.sig] to select the implementation.
the module local resolved from msg.sig is the recipient of the delegated call.
the success local of the module call controls the fallback's return/revert path.
the _guardValue mutex is the only storage-based reentrancy protection available to the wallet entry points.
addToWhitelist clamps the whitelist effective time against block.timestamp.
addGuardian requires validSince >= block.timestamp.
removeGuardian requires validUntil >= block.timestamp.
touchLastActive stores block.timestamp as the wallet's last activity.
setInheritor writes block.timestamp into lastActive, arming the inheritance delay.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired compares block.timestamp with lastActive + interval to decide authorization.
setLock writes the locked flag inside the wallets mapping.
touchLastActive updates wallets[wallet].lastActive.
setInheritor writes the inheritor and waiting period into the wallet struct.
touchLastActiveWhenRequired conditionally updates the wallet's lastActive slot.
addGuardian mutates the guardian array of the target wallet.
removeGuardian rewrites the guardian status and timestamp in storage.
removeAllGuardians deletes every guardian entry of the wallet.
cancelPendingGuardians rewrites pending guardian statuses in storage.
_cleanRemovedGuardians compacts and re-indexes the guardian array.
checkAndAddToSpent loads the wallet quota struct before spending.
checkAndAddToSpent writes the increased spent amount and timestamp back into the quota.
changeQuota writes current and pending quota values into the quota struct.
verifyAndUpdate reads hashes[wallet][hash] for replay protection.
verifyAndUpdate marks the signed-request hash as consumed.
requireWalletModule gates hash consumption on msg.sender being a wallet module.
onlyWalletModule restricts addGuardian to an authorized module of the wallet.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule gates addModule on msg.sender.
onlyFromModule gates removeModule on msg.sender.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule gates the arbitrary transact entry point on msg.sender.
onlyFromModule gates setController, which reassigns factory and store trust.
onlyFromModule gates bindMethod, which controls fallback routing.
onlyProxyOwner gates the implementation upgrade on msg.sender.
onlyPendingOwner gates claimOwnership on msg.sender.
BaseModule.activate treats msg.sender as the wallet whose methods are bound.
Claimable.transferOwnership records the new pending owner.
the newOwner argument is stored in pendingOwner rather than owner.
claimOwnership promotes the pending owner into the owner slot.
pendingOwner authorizes claimOwnership and is cleared afterwards.
upgradeToAndCall executes a self-directed low-level call with msg.value after upgrading.
the called implementation can re-enter the proxy while the upgrade call is running.
upgradeToAndCall first performs the owner-only implementation upgrade.
Proxy.fallback delegatecalls the implementation for every unmatched selector.
implementation code re-enters the proxy through the same fallback path.
UpgraderModule.activate treats msg.sender as the wallet that is being upgraded.
UpgraderModule.activate removes obsolete modules from the caller wallet.
UpgraderModule.activate installs the new module set on the caller wallet.
addManager writes the manager into the MANAGER AddressSet used for authorization.
addManager inserts into the set structure backing onlyManager checks.
removeManager deletes the manager from the authorization set.
setController replaces the controller that supplies the trusted stores and factory.
bindMethod writes methodToModule[_method], changing fallback routing.
activate binds all bindable methods of the module onto the wallet.
deactivate unbinds the module methods from the wallet.
addToWhitelist stores the effective time in effectiveTimeMap.
addToWhitelist writes the clamped effective time into the whitelist map.
the manager argument becomes a new privileged manager.
the amount argument is priced and charged against the wallet quota.
the newQuota argument is persisted as the pending quota.
the effectiveTime argument determines when the higher quota becomes usable.
the hash argument is the replay-protection key being consumed.
the implementation argument becomes the delegatecall target of the proxy.
the data argument is the payload of the post-upgrade self call.
the success local of the self call is checked by a require.
the available quota local gates whether the spend is authorized.
the oracle-derived value local is compared against the available quota.
the wallet argument selects the storage struct being modified in addGuardian.
the addr argument is inserted into the guardian index map.
validSince sets the future activation timestamp of the guardian.
the g local Guardian struct is pushed into the wallet's guardian array.
the pos local index controls which guardian slot is overwritten.
alwaysOverride lets the caller extend or replace a pending guardian addition.
the wallet argument selects the guardian array to modify in removeGuardian.
the addr argument is looked up in guardianIdx to locate the entry.
validUntil sets the future removal timestamp of the guardian.
the cancelled local decides whether the caller is re-authorized as a module.
the count local bounds the backwards compaction loop over guardians.
